about: Allow list for tools/shadow-diff.py on edf_native_shadow_render captures. Every rule is an expected exclusion (the shadow render's own design), a register or slot the shaders do not read, or a capture limitation: lists recorded before the tap kept only the slots a pipeline's shaders read (reflected=false), or without constant bytes (constant_bytes=false). Real renderer discrepancies are deliberately NOT here: a blended reorder, a blended pass order, a live register (constants.vs0.<variable> other than the unread ones below), an instance stream that is not the paired worlds (world.instances) and the image pixels stay reported. Rules marked reflected=false or constant_bytes=false stop matching on captures that have what they lack, so an excuse for a capture limitation cannot hide a real difference there. Model vertex constants are verified register by register only on captures with edf_native_shadow_render_constants=1.

draws.reason: tone hold: the guest post's PS_Downsample_Tone draw is held so the GPU tone history blends once per frame
draws.evidence: kNativeShadowExclusions 'tone'; one extra native.post draw per frame, 1x1 target, the only 400106f0 draw; shadow.json held.tone=1 on all 16 frames

draws.reason: the post's resolve copies (conv shaders) set no constants: their constant slots hold the previous draw's, which after the held tone draw is the tone draw's on the native side and the previous copy's on the guest side
draws.evidence: native#626 ps0 = the tone draw's ps0 hash, guest#695 ps0 = the 2x2 copy's; same source texture, same 1x1 target

draws.reason: post passes: slots 1-3 hold what the scene passes left bound (native: the 2048x2048 shadow cascades; guest: its last material's) and the quad vertex shader's constant slot the previous shader's; slot 0 (the pass input), the tone and bloom inputs, the pixel constants and the targets all match
draws.evidence: every native.post pair matches on texture.1.0, ps constants and targets; frames 4060-4900 post output matches to +-1 except geometry edges

draws.reason: slot 4 on static world materials: the guest leaves the 256x256 texture every guest draw had in slot 4 bound; the native material binds only its declared textures
draws.evidence: 515 of 2312 static world instances, 5 materials; everything else on them matches. Open: whether these pixel shaders read slot 4 (a reflected capture reports texture.1.4.missing if they do)

draws.reason: model vertex registers the shaders do not read. g_mWorldArray.tail: palette registers past the native palette, which BindNativeFullFrameModelPalette writes over zeroed registers; both paths write the same bone count (821A1738: min(pose bones, descriptor+16)) and past it the guest's scratch keeps its (0,0,0,1) fill or an earlier object's bones (the guest would draw garbage if a vertex indexed them). A rigid Common.fx shader (VS_Main) reads no palette at all, so all of c4-c207 is tail for it. g_mWorld.instanced: the constant image of a world-instanced alternate, which reads its world from the EDFINSTANCE stream (AddNativeWorldInstancing rewrites every g_mWorld use; the declaration stays for the layout); the stream itself is checked against the paired worlds (instance_streams, world.instances)
draws.evidence: shadow2c (50c1d8f, edf_native_shadow_render_constants=1), 16 frames: all 3936 differing model pairs (246 per frame, 12 materials) classify as these two alone once paired by register content; every live palette bone and every rigid g_mWorld is bit-exact, c208-c237 (g_mView, g_mViewTranspose, g_mViewProjection, g_mProjection, lights, fog, material, g_Time/g_Highlight/g_Scroll) never differ; all 73 expanded instances per frame verify their instance stream bit for bit in guest order; $Globals layout from fxc vs_5_0 over the disc's Shader/*.dxsl (g_mWorld c0, g_mWorldArray[68] float4x3 c4-c207, g_mView c208) in all 59 vertex entries of that size

draws.reason: a model draw's vertex constant image as a hash only: the palette tail and the instanced alternates' g_mWorld (the unread-registers rule) always differ, and without the bytes the tool cannot tell those from a live register. Verified register by register on constants captures, where this rule does not apply
draws.evidence: shadow2 (no bytes) and shadow2c (bytes) of the same build and scene have the same 246 differing model pairs per frame on constants.vs0 only; on shadow2c every one is unread registers

draws.reason: the native models pass groups the opaque (non-blending) draws between two blending draws on (pass index, batch, pass record) so identical draws instance; the guest draws them in callback order. An opaque depth-tested draw's order matters only at exact depth ties. A blending draw keeps its guest place (NativeFullFrameModelOpaqueOrder); a reordered blending draw has the field 'blended' and is not excused
draws.evidence: shadow2/shadow2c: 53-57 opaque reorders per frame, all within native.models (the instanced 88390141/8839c861/87b19f81/88398a01/88390ce1 groups)
